thread:
Aisha: Weird spike in candidate complaints this morning: some report getting two different interview invites for the same role, 24h apart.
Tom: Any common factor? timezones / browser?
Riley: Looks like webhook consumer normalized scheduled_at from ATS to local date-only for candidates in India. When we re-sent updated slots later the system normalized differently (UTC vs IST) and created a duplicate slot with a different internal id.
ops-bot: Found 12 duplicate invite events between 2024-09-03T02:00:00Z and 2024-09-03T04:30:00Z. Sample event: `{"candidate_id":"C-1243","scheduled_at":"2024-09-10","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","source":"ats-webhook"}`
Tom: So the webhook sent date-only strings for all non-UTC timezones? That would lose offset.
Riley: Yes. Two-step cause: ATS migration script switched to date-only when event had no time component, then our invite-factory assumed midnight UTC and stamped a 00:00Z slot. Later queue reprocessing used the candidate's locale and interpreted date as midnight local, so different absolute times.
Zoe: Mitigation: bulk-cancel invites with duplicate external_reference and resend canonical ISO times. I can run a query to find invites where external_reference matches and scheduled_at differs by exactly 24h.
Aisha: Do that, please. Also add a temporary validation in admin UI that rejects date-only webhook events and surfaces a warning.
Tom: I'll add a short-lived webhook filter in api-gateway to reject date-only scheduled_at with 400 and return helpful text to ATS team. Can deploy in 30m.
Riley: Longer term fix: update invite-factory to canonicalize using the timezone field if present and persist both original_payload and normalized_time to avoid reprocessing ambiguity.
recruiter-bot: Action recorded: query-run requested by Zoe, webhook-filter planned by Tom.
QA-bot: We'll add a test case for date-only payloads and verify dedupe behavior end-to-end.
Aisha: Also note for interviewer training: if you see candidates receiving two invites, check the external_reference id and don't book duplicate times. We'll add a FAQ and a one-paragraph SOP in the interviewer playbook.
Zoe: Running dedupe query now. Will DM results and I'll hold on resends until we confirm which invites to cancel.
Tom: Patch pushed to gateway -> canary 2% -> looks good -> rolling to 100%.
ops-bot: Duplicate-invite alert resolved. 8 candidates affected were contacted and offered apologies + reschedule help.
Aisha: Thanks team. Please capture this in a short blameless incident note and assign follow-ups (webhook spec update, invite-factory change, training doc).
